_comment: Times in seconds from the start of the file, the same clock as the recordings. The panel subtracts the manifest's lead_in to put them on the playhead.
source: Words: Joseph Mohr, 1816, in the English of John Freeman Young, 1859. Melody: Franz Gruber, 1818. All long out of copyright.
_caveat: The two verses are the standard ones and the timing was measured, but nobody has yet listened to the recording against these words to confirm it sings them in this order. Check by ear before a performance.
_timing_note: Each verse is twelve bars, two bars to a line, so the six lines divide it evenly. Checked against the soprano's held notes: every internal line end agrees within 0.25s, most within 0.15s.

lines.text: All is calm, all is bright
Round yon Virgin Mother and Child
Holy Infant so tender and mild

_stops_note: The recording carries a third verse. The song is set to stop at the end of the second, in songs.json, so the words stop there too.
